entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The supreme law of the United States, ratified in 1788. Establishing a federal republic with separation of powers, it drew on Enlightenment philosophy, Magna Carta, and Roman republican ideals. The Bill of Rights (1791) added fundamental civil liberties.
